gloss: feel to the touch; texture (of fabric); how something feels on the skin

definitions.gloss: feel to the touch; texture against the skin
definitions.explanation: How a material or surface feels when it touches the skin, especially regarding fabric and clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肌触|はだざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This shirt feels nice against the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦シルク→シルク：28530_shiruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肌触|はだざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the feel of silk against my skin.

examples.japanese: {肌触|はだざわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a towel with a nice texture.

notes:
{肌触|はだざわ}り combines ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin) and ⟦{触|さわ}り→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ (touch): how a material feels against the skin. It is a selling point in Japanese descriptions of clothing, bedding, and towels.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肌触|はだざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (feels nice against the skin)
- {肌触|はだざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (feels rough or unpleasant)
- {肌触|はだざわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (material with a good feel)
- ⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{肌触|はだざわ}り (a smooth, silky feel)

RELATED 〜{触|ざわ}り WORDS:
- ⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧: how something feels to the hand
- ⟦{舌触|したざわ}り→舌触り：07919_shitazawari⟧: how something feels on the tongue
- ⟦{耳障|みみざわ}り→耳障り：20216_mimizawari⟧: grating on the ears — note the different kanji {障|ざわ} and the negative meaning
